{{documentation subpage}}

== Function ==
This template links to books created via [[Wikipedia:Books]].

== Usage ==
The <nowiki>{{Wikipedia books}}</nowiki> template accepts three optional parameters for linking to books.
* The first parameter is the name of the book within the Wikipedia:Books project. If omitted the template will use the name of the page.
* The second parameter is the text to use for the wikilink. If omitted the template will either use the name of the book given as the first parameter or the name of the page.
* The {{para|position}} parameter accepts one keyword, <code>left</code>, to float the box to the left instead of to the right.

Examples:
{|class="wikitable"
|-
! # of books !! What you write !! What you get
|-
| One book<br>plain
| <pre>{{Wikipedia books|Chemical elements (sorted by number)}}</pre>
| {{Wikipedia books|Chemical elements (sorted by number)}}
|-
| One book<br>renamed
| <pre>
{{Wikipedia books
 |Chemical elements (sorted by number)
 |Chemical elements
}}</pre>
| {{Wikipedia books|Chemical elements (sorted by number)|Chemical elements}}
|-
| Three books<br>plain
|
<pre>{{Wikipedia books
 |1=Chemistry
 |3=Chemical elements (sorted by number)
 |5=Chemical elements (sorted alphabetically)
}}</pre>
|
{{Wikipedia books
 |1=Chemistry
 |3=Chemical elements (sorted by number)
 |5=Chemical elements (sorted alphabetically)
}}
|-
|-
| Three books<br>renamed
|
<pre>{{Wikipedia books
 |1=Chemistry
 |2=Chemistry
 |3=Chemical elements (sorted by number)
 |4=Chemical Elements (#) 
 |5=Chemical elements (sorted alphabetically)
 |6=Chemical Elements (A–Z) 
}}</pre>
|
{{Wikipedia books
 |1=Chemistry |2=Chemistry
 |3=Chemical elements (sorted by number)|4=Chemical Elements (#) 
 |5=Chemical elements (sorted alphabetically)|6=Chemical Elements (A–Z) 
}}
|}

The template supports up to five books, following the parameter numbering pattern shown above.

===Location===
Within articles, this template is meant to be placed at the bottom of the article in the ''See also'' section.
